question: Who among the following is the author of the book ‘The Guide’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**RK Narayan**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **RK Narayan** is the author of the book 'The Guide'.
 
• 'The Guide' is one of Narayan's most famous works and has been adapted into both a film and a play.
 
• RK Narayan is a celebrated Indian writer known for his works set in the fictional South Indian town of Malgudi.
 
• His writing style is marked by simplicity and subtle humor, and he is considered one of the leading figures in early Indian literature in English.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• RK Narayan was born on October 10, 1906, in Madras (now Chennai), India.
 
• He was a prolific writer and published numerous novels, short stories, essays, and memoirs throughout his career.
 
• Some of his other notable works include 'Swami and Friends', 'The Bachelor of Arts', and 'The English Teacher'.
 
• He received several prestigious awards, including the Sahitya Akademi Award, the Padma Bhushan, and the Padma Vibhushan.
 
• RK Narayan passed away on May 13, 2001, but his literary contributions continue to be celebrated and studied.
